content.comment_body: These two files should be downloaded from [company_name] Netherlands at [url]: - Language.nl_NL.properties - Help_nl_NL.jar After downloading, move the files to the specified folders: - Place "Language.nl_NL.properties" in the folder "C:\programs\[company_name]\[product_name]_V8.1" - Place "Help_nl_NL.jar" in "C:\programs\[company_name]\[product_name]_V8.1\help"

There is a small mistake with the first filename. You need to change Language.nl_NL.properties to Language_nl_NL.properties (replace the dot with an underscore), otherwise it won’t work. (Sorry for my poor English)
If you want "Nederlands" to appear instead of "language.nl_NL" in the language options, you can do this as shown in the attached file.

Thanks for confirming. The downloaded file Language.nl_NL.properties needs to be renamed to Language_nl_NL.properties. To adjust the displayed language name, you can add it to Language.properties. Hopefully, the Dutch branch will update these files so everything is correct from the start.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced issues with the Dutch localization pack for [product_name] V8.1 due to incorrect file naming provided during download. Manual renaming and configuration editing were required to ensure the language displayed properly. This caused unnecessary steps and confusion during setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the localization pack to work immediately after download, with correct file names and display language pre-configured, requiring no extra manual adjustments.
